::: {#exm-proposal-distribution}
#### A Gaussian random-walk proposal

For a scalar parameter $\prob$,
the proposal $\prob^* \mid \prob \sim \ndist{\prob, 0.05^2}$
draws a candidate within about $\pm 0.1$ of the current value $\prob$.
It is [symmetric](#def-symmetric-proposal): $q(\prob^* \mid \prob) = q(\prob \mid \prob^*)$,
because the Gaussian density depends on $\prob^* - \prob$ only through its square.
:::
